ValidationRule.description: Requires Disqualified Reason if status is Disqualified for new Lead Person Status field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Lead_Person_Status__c, "Disqualified"), ISBLANK(Text(Lead_Disqualified_Reason__c)), NOT($UserRole.Name = "Admin") ) && Lead_Val_Bypass__c = False
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Disqualified reason must be filled in.
